pairs.subject: audit-logging
pairs.evidence: src/athena/proving/playbooks/__main__.py:222 Rescoring writes into the original report directory, replacing previously recorded results instead of preserving the original and appending a referenced correction.

techniques.evidence: src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:751 The writer overwrites report.json; the rescore command supplies the original directory, destroying the previous recorded assessment.

src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:664 The replay reader traverses one report without actor/action/subject/time-window filters; its turn records also lack structured actor and per-action timestamps.
src/athena/proving/playbooks/__main__.py:232 After the simulated actions complete, persistence errors escape this call without a durable failed-write counter or surfaced accounting for lost evidence.
src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:357 The bench mechanically approves cards under approve=all; it does not collect human judgments dismissing regenerated findings.

src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:327 The inspected storage model accumulates action turns into JSON snapshots, rather than maintaining versioned rows with recorded/invalidated intervals requiring held-at predicates.
src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:802 Only summary headlines receive the twelve-entry bound; full run reports have no enforced horizon, and headline retirement produces no surviving trim record.

src/athena/proving/playbooks/evidence.py:561 Verification recomputes unkeyed media checksums against the editable index; it does not authenticate benchmark record content against an operator able to replace both artifacts and hashes.

src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:190 The bench originates the simulated actions it records; rescored_at separately dates recomputation, rather than representing late arrival of an externally occurring fact.

src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:747 The persistence door accepts arbitrary mappings and writes them without enforcing required audit fields, timestamp assignment, sanitization, retention or failure accounting.
src/athena/proving/playbooks/bench.py:312 Card parameters enter the persisted report verbatim; the report writer applies no payload allowlist, secret scrubber or parameter size cap.
